name: oxo-flow-methylseq
title: Bisulfite methylation analysis: alignment, methylation calls and QC
excluded: single_end — paired-end only; the upstream samplesheet 'single_end' column is not ported
CAT_FASTQ — only active for samples with more than one fastq pair; fixture samplesheets have one pair per sample
GUNZIP / UNTAR — only active when a prebuilt --bismark_index is supplied; the port always builds the index from the reference FASTA (upstream default)
PARABRICS_FQ2BAMMETH — GPU-only bwameth path (nvcr.io container, conda-incompatible; errors under conda/mamba upstream)
qualimap -gd HUMAN/MOUSE — upstream derives it from the --genome param, which the port does not model
rastair chain for bismark/bwameth aligners with taps — the port wires rastair to the bwamem chain only (upstream recommends bwamem for TAPS and warns on other aligners)
bamqc_regions_file as a declared input — passed via --gff but not checkpoint-tracked (DRAFT deviation)
description: Run end-to-end bisulfite methylation analysis (WGBS, RRBS-compatible, and TAPS) of paired-end reads: FastQC quality control, TrimGalore adapter trimming, alignment with Bismark (bowtie2 or hisat2), bwameth or bwa-mem, PCR-deduplication, samtools sort/index/stats, Bismark or MethylDackel methylation extraction (CpG/CHG/CHH, methylKit output), the rastair TAPS C->T conversion chain, targeted-sequencing intersection and hybrid-selection metrics, QualiMap bamQC and Preseq complexity QC, per-sample and project-wide Bismark reports, and a final MultiQC report. The default bismark (bowtie2) path is live-verified; the bwameth/bwamem/taps/targeted/qualimap/preseq branches are DRAFT (dry-run gated, not yet live-tested).

requirements: reference genome FASTA (uncompressed) — the per-aligner index (Bismark bowtie2/hisat2, bwameth, bwa) is built automatically on first run; no prebuilt index required
compute: up to 12 CPUs / 72 GB RAM per rule (bismark_genomepreparation, bwameth_index, bwameth_align, bwa_mem, trimgalore, bismark_align, bismark_deduplicate, bismark_methylationextractor)
conda or mamba to create the pinned per-rule environments
disk: space in config.out_dir (default results/) for aligned BAMs, methylation calls and reports
